name: @factory/promo
description: The factory explained in thirty seconds, rendered from the real parts.

scripts.render: cp ../../packages/ui/src/styles.css src/style.css && remotion render src/index.ts SoftwareFactory out/software-factory.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --scale 2
scripts.render:gif: cp ../../packages/ui/src/styles.css src/style.css && remotion render src/index.ts SoftwareFactory out/software-factory.gif --codec gif --every-nth-frame 3 --scale 0.7
scripts.still: cp ../../packages/ui/src/styles.css src/style.css && remotion still src/index.ts SoftwareFactory out/still.png
